home.text1: I'm Steffen, a digital creative working at the seam of design and code.
home.text2: After years working purely as a designer, I doubled down on my fascination for development and learned how to code.
home.text3: I catch the small things that make a design work and I can implement them directly, so nothing gets lost between Figma and production.
